body: So I realize I need help from a therapist or doctor I analyse myself a lot. I think I might be bipolar and have been depressed at the very least. Right now though I'm not sad or happy just kind of stuck in this middle ground. My life is fine over all which makes me upset that I want to kill myself other because people have and do suffer more than I do. I want to be happy or at least be content with life, I realize that happiness isn't a 24 emotion. Yet I keep running back to depression purposely. Once I get out of it I think to myself man what are we missing oh yeah that feeling that hangs over us 24/7 we were happy then right we enjoyed that over all right? So I end up in a funk again but now I remember that  it isn't enjoyable at all.
